analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (71,740 KRW) is above SMA5 (69,873 KRW) but below SMA20 (96,898 KRW). Short-term rebound attempt, but below mid-term trend.
· Significantly lower than SMA100 (132,840 KRW) and SMA200 (112,026 KRW). Long-term trend is weak.
· At 52-week position (22.9%), approaching historical low range, potential for further decline.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.0→32.1) continues in oversold territory, weak rebound attempt.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3227.9465→-3648.2026) worsening, weakness persists.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 60,213 KRW) approaching bottom, band width 75.72% indicates expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Approaching swing support (68,045 KRW), aligning with 5-day low.
· Swing resistance (80,380 KRW) is distant.
· 5-day high 74,365 KRW, 20-day high 120,080 KRW. Lower High pattern confirmed, trend weakening.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.04x) is normal, indicating moderate confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Weak rebound attempt within a downtrend. Further downside potential suggests maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
